@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+import ssl
+import os
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils import urls
+
+
+def test_make_context_accepts_ordered_cipher_list():
+    context = urls.make_context(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 'ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384'])
+    names = [item['name'] for item in context.get_ciphers()]
+    assert names.index('ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256') < names.index('ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384')
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_REQUIRED
+
+
+def test_make_context_accepts_openssl_cipher_string_without_certificate_validation():
+    context = urls.make_context(ciphers='ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', validate_certs=False)
+    assert 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' in [item['name'] for item in context.get_ciphers()]
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_NONE
+    assert context.options & ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers', [[], ['INVALID-CIPHER'], 42, ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 42],
+                                     ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 'INVALID-CIPHER']])
+def test_make_context_rejects_invalid_ciphers_without_echoing_values(ciphers):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='ciphers') as exc:
+        urls.make_context(ciphers=ciphers)
+    assert 'INVALID-CIPHER' not in str(exc.value)
+
+
+def test_request_applies_ciphers_to_https_handler_on_http_redirect(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen')
+    installed = mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'install_opener')
+    urls.Request(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256']).open('GET', 'http://example.org/')
+    opener = installed.call_args[0][0]
+    handlers = [handler for handler in opener.handlers if isinstance(handler, urls.CustomHTTPSHandler)]
+    assert handlers
+    assert 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' in [item['name'] for item in handlers[0]._context.get_ciphers()]
+
+
+def test_request_unix_https_handler_uses_custom_ca_with_ciphers(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen')
+    installed = mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'install_opener')
+    cafile = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'fixtures', 'client.pem')
+    urls.Request(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256'], ca_path=cafile, unix_socket='/tmp/example.sock').open(
+        'GET', 'https://example.org/')
+    opener = installed.call_args[0][0]
+    handlers = [handler for handler in opener.handlers if isinstance(handler, urls.HTTPSClientAuthHandler)]
+    assert handlers[0]._context.cert_store_stats()['x509'] == 1
+
+
+def test_request_unix_https_handler_preserves_default_context(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen')
+    installed = mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'install_opener')
+    urls.Request(unix_socket='/tmp/example.sock').open('GET', 'https://example.org/')
+    opener = installed.call_args[0][0]
+    handlers = [handler for handler in opener.handlers if isinstance(handler, urls.HTTPSClientAuthHandler)]
+    assert handlers[0]._context is None

+import pytest
+
+from ansible.modules import get_url, uri
+
+
+class StopFetch(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('module, call', [
+    (get_url, lambda task: get_url.url_get(task, 'http://example.org/', '/tmp/example', True, None, False)),
+    (uri, lambda task: uri.uri(task, 'http://example.org/', None, None, 'raw', 'GET', {}, 10, None, None, True)),
+])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers', [None, ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256']])
+def test_modules_pass_ciphers_to_fetch_url(mocker, module, call, ciphers):
+    task = type('Task', (), {'params': {'src': None, 'unix_socket': None, 'use_proxy': True, 'ciphers': ciphers}})()
+
+    def stop_at_fetch(*args, **kwargs):
+        assert kwargs['ciphers'] == ciphers
+        raise StopFetch()
+
+    mocker.patch.object(module, 'fetch_url', side_effect=stop_at_fetch)
+    with pytest.raises(StopFetch):
+        call(task)

@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+import ssl
+import os
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils import urls
+
+
+def test_make_context_accepts_ordered_cipher_list():
+    context = urls.make_context(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 'ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384'])
+    names = [item['name'] for item in context.get_ciphers()]
+    assert names.index('ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256') < names.index('ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384')
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_REQUIRED
+
+
+def test_make_context_accepts_openssl_cipher_string_without_certificate_validation():
+    context = urls.make_context(ciphers='ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', validate_certs=False)
+    assert 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' in [item['name'] for item in context.get_ciphers()]
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_NONE
+    assert context.options & ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers', [[], ['INVALID-CIPHER'], 42, ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 42],
+                                     ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 'INVALID-CIPHER']])
+def test_make_context_rejects_invalid_ciphers_without_echoing_values(ciphers):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='ciphers') as exc:
+        urls.make_context(ciphers=ciphers)
+    assert 'INVALID-CIPHER' not in str(exc.value)
+
+
+def test_request_applies_ciphers_to_https_handler_on_http_redirect(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen')
+    installed = mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'install_opener')
+    urls.Request(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256']).open('GET', 'http://example.org/')
+    opener = installed.call_args[0][0]
+    handlers = [handler for handler in opener.handlers if isinstance(handler, urls.CustomHTTPSHandler)]
+    assert handlers
+    assert 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' in [item['name'] for item in handlers[0]._context.get_ciphers()]
+
+
+def test_request_unix_https_handler_uses_custom_ca_with_ciphers(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen')
+    installed = mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'install_opener')
+    cafile = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'fixtures', 'client.pem')
+    urls.Request(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256'], ca_path=cafile, unix_socket='/tmp/example.sock').open(
+        'GET', 'https://example.org/')
+    opener = installed.call_args[0][0]
+    handlers = [handler for handler in opener.handlers if isinstance(handler, urls.HTTPSClientAuthHandler)]
+    assert handlers[0]._context.cert_store_stats()['x509'] == 1
+
+
+def test_request_unix_https_handler_preserves_default_context(mocker):

+import pytest
+
+from ansible.modules import get_url, uri
+
+
+class StopFetch(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('module, call', [
+    (get_url, lambda task: get_url.url_get(task, 'http://example.org/', '/tmp/example', True, None, False)),
+    (uri, lambda task: uri.uri(task, 'http://example.org/', None, None, 'raw', 'GET', {}, 10, None, None, True)),
+])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers', [None, ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256']])
+def test_modules_pass_ciphers_to_fetch_url(mocker, module, call, ciphers):
+    task = type('Task', (), {'params': {'src': None, 'unix_socket': None, 'use_proxy': True, 'ciphers': ciphers}})()
+
+    def stop_at_fetch(*args, **kwargs):
+        assert kwargs['ciphers'] == ciphers
+        raise StopFetch()
+
+    mocker.patch.object(module, 'fetch_url', side_effect=stop_at_fetch)
+    with pytest.raises(StopFetch):
+        call(task)
